name: 今日の三つの学びを終える
prompt:
Edit Reference 1 to match Reference 2, which is the authoritative 390×460 native component preview. Preserve the same content, but correct size and alignment to the exact native geometry below. References 3–5 are the exact original image files for the flame, stacked books and timer. Place each inside a 52×52 image box using contain-fit scaling, keeping its original aspect ratio, transparent background and colors. Do not stretch, crop, redraw or recolor the artwork.

The user dislikes tint colors. The full canvas and list card must be pure white #FFFFFF. Use no cream, mint, pale green, blue-gray or other tinted interface fills; no gradients, glows, shadows or textures. Use neutral #E4E4E4 for the card outline and row dividers. Use solid forest green #047857 only for completed check circles, the completion strip and the confirmation button. Any orange, yellow, purple and blue color belongs only to the three original icon images.

Exact layout, 390×460: heading x=16/y=16, 358×28, Meiryo Bold 20/28, #1D1D1D, “今日の学び”. White list card x=16/y=66, 358×246, 12 px corners, 1 px #E4E4E4 outline. Row one icon at x=32/y=78, 52×52; label x=104/y=96, 212×24, Meiryo Regular 14/24, “連続学習を始める”; check circle x=336/y=96, 20×20, centered white check. Divider x=32/y=148, 326×1, #E4E4E4. Row two icon x=32/y=160, 52×52; label x=104/y=178, “要約をひとつ読み終える”; check x=336/y=178. Divider x=32/y=230, 326×1, #E4E4E4. Row three icon x=32/y=242, 52×52; label x=104/y=260, “10分間学ぶ”; check x=336/y=260. All row labels are #1D1D1D Meiryo Regular 14/24.

The green completion strip begins immediately at the card bottom: x=16/y=312, 358×30, 4 px corners, solid #047857. Center exact text “今日の三つの学びを終えました” in white Meiryo Regular 12/16. Confirmation button x=16/y=382, 358×44, 10 px corners, solid #047857; centered white Meiryo Regular 14/24, exact text “確認しました”. Keep the 40 px gap from strip to button.

In Reference 1 the heading and row text are too large, the first two icons are enlarged, and the completion strip floats below the card. Correct those differences to the native preview. Keep the icon art’s original proportions and do not add any tinted surfaces or extra elements. Return only the component canvas.
reviewNotes: Near-white UI surfaces without tint fills; card/strip align; confirmation text weight and two icon scales remain unresolved after one correction.
